tool_input.description: Preview can_client data and row count
tool_input.sql:
SELECT count(*) as total_clients,
       count(advisor_id) as with_advisor,
       count(distinct client_segment) as segments,
       round(avg(total_aum), 2) as avg_aum,
       round(sum(total_aum), 2) as total_aum
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_CLIENT
